scope: Offline wearable metadata trace auditing and local browser review. No real Meta invocation, physical-glasses execution or runtime device enforcement verified.

review.security: Independent source review against release spec: no material unresolved findings. SARIF metadata hardening applied after review.
review.privacy: Pattern scan of 103 tracked files (86 text files) found no matches for checked personal identities, private paths/destinations or credential patterns. Only synthetic fixtures and reviewed demo images are included; this is not an exhaustive privacy guarantee.
review.format: Ruff format/check for new Python; Prettier for new web assets, docs and workflow.

dependencies.limitation: Advisory scans are point-in-time checks, not proof of absence of vulnerabilities.

benchmark.scope: Synthetic all-capture trace, parsing plus validation plus audit, one local Python3.12 process; not a hardware or competitor benchmark.

limits: Events, timestamps, bystander status, approval and content hashes are supplied metadata, not independently attested evidence.
A clean audit does not prove an integration or action is safe; a finding does not mean Swan blocked a real action.
One active device and one monotonic clock per trace; use fresh permission state and capture-ready session epochs after reconnect.
The auditor processes no raw camera/audio/transcript content and cannot detect bystanders or semantic prompt injection.
The optional metadata-only review server is loopback-only and has no media/model routes. Legacy OCR experiments retain their own local artifacts.
The reference replay browser check was not run because no stored receipts were present.
The benchmark is a local synthetic workload, not a hardware or competitor performance comparison.
Public GitHub CI status is checked separately after push.
